prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry, and whether you need strategy, creative, media buying, data engineering, or an end-to-end partner. That said, here are several reputable LA-area agencies and networks known for strong AI, data, and performance capabilities (good starting points):

- Wpromote — LA-based performance marketing agency that emphasizes data-driven/AI optimization for paid media and customer acquisition. Good for growth-focused brands.
- R/GA — Global creative and technology agency with strong data science and AI-driven product/marketing work; good for brands that need integrated creative + tech.
- Tinuiti — Digital marketing and e-commerce specialist using analytics and AI for paid search, social, and retail media.
- Accenture Song (formerly Droga5/Accenture Interactive) — Enterprise-level digital transformation and marketing with deep AI and data capabilities.
- VaynerMedia — Full-service agency with strong social, creative, and analytics teams; uses AI tools to scale content and targeting.
- Merkle (part of Dentsu) / Epsilon — Customer data platform and CRM-focused agencies with advanced AI personalization and data engineering.
- Boutique AI/data shops — There are smaller LA firms and consultancies that specialize in AI-driven marketing, analytics, and ML engineering if you need technical implementation rather than big-agency creative.

How to pick the right one
- Objective: performance (ROI, CAC), brand/creative, personalization, or AI product development?
- Industry fit: e‑commerce, entertainment, healthcare, B2B, etc.
- Scale: SMB vs mid-market vs enterprise.
- Tech stack & data: Do they integrate with your CDP/CRM/analytics? Do they build custom models or use third-party AI platforms?
- Measurement: How do they report ROI and prove lift (A/B tests, incrementality)?
- Compliance & privacy: relevant if in regulated industries or using customer data.
- Budget & timeline: agency size and hourly rates/retainer vs project-based pricing.

Questions to ask agencies
- Can you show case studies with measurable outcomes (revenue lift, ROAS, conversion improvement)?
- What AI tools/platforms do you use, and what do you build in-house?
- How do you handle data integration, security, and privacy?
- Who will be on the team, and what are their qualifications?
- What will success look like after 3 and 6 months?

If you’d like, I can:
- Shortlist 3 LA agencies matched to your industry, budget and goals.
- Draft an RFP or a comparison checklist you can use when interviewing agencies.
Tell me your primary goal, monthly budget range, industry, and whether you already have data systems (CDP/CRM/analytics).
